findings.quote: I used the full drop height for the constant-speed stage
findings.note: This says the same thing as mistakes[1]'s route, 'I divided the whole height by the constant speed' - both students divide the whole height by the constant speed. The one feature that separates this entry is that the free-fall time was still added on top, and the route never says so, so the two sit on the menu as near-synonyms and a student cannot reliably pick their own.
findings.fix: I added the free-fall time but used the whole height

notes: I checked the solution: the free-fall stage gives a speed of twenty metres per second in two seconds, the remaining height takes ninety-nine seconds, and the total is the second option; each entry lands on the option it names. All three types are 'application' and all three fit - a stage dropped, both stages collapsed into one, and the wrong height used for a stage - with routes present as required. mistakes[0] and mistakes[1] are tellable apart from each other and from the right route. The proposed replacement for mistakes[2] also keeps it distinct from right_route, which uses the remaining height rather than the whole height.
